test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

The laws are strong but never __enforced__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Imposed**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Imposed **means to establish something as a rule to be obeyed, or to force the acceptance of something. (पालन ​​​​करने के लिए एक नियम के रूप में कुछ स्थापित करना, या कुछ की स्वीकृति के लिए मजबूर करना)

 
 
• Example -* The decision was theirs and was not imposed on them by others.*
 
 
 
• The underlined word **Enforced **means to make people obey a law, or to make a particular situation happen or be accepted. (लोगों को एक कानून का पालन करने के लिए, या किसी विशेष स्थिति को घटित करने या स्वीकार करने के लिए)
 
 
• Example -* It isn't always easy for the police to enforce speed limits.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that '**Imposed**' and '**Enforced**' are similar in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 3.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Diluted **means a liquid weakened by the addition of water or another solvent. (पानी या किसी अन्य विलायक के अतिरिक्त एक तरल कमजोर)
 
• **Abandoned **means to leave behind or run away from someone or something, or to give up something. (किसी को या किसी चीज़ को पीछे छोड़ना या भागना, या कुछ छोड़ना)
 
• **Disregarded **means lack of consideration or respect. (विचार या सम्मान की कमी)
